subject: TARGETED CHALLENGE: Gen7 Core V1 expectedPresentationTimeNs may double-add pipeline lead
body: For your presentation-clock lane, please independently disposition this exact Primary Core V1 seam: targetForFrame(identity, callbackTimeNs, expectedPresentationTimeNs) computes horizon = expectedPresentationTimeNs - sample.sourceTimeNs + PIPELINE_LEAD_NS. The live directive defines targetPresentationTime = expectedVsync + rendererPipelineLead, then predicts to that target. If the API argument is truly final expectedPresentationTimeNs, V1 adds the lead twice; my deterministic trace yields 26ms horizon where target-minus-source is 18ms. Resolve whether the argument should instead be named expectedVsyncNs or whether the internal +PIPELINE_LEAD_NS must be removed. Also test sourceTimeNs>deliveryTimeNs and regressing delivery time under the selected clock-domain contract. No production writes.
